concerns: Pair 18: 薬 is read as ぐすり. While 薬 can be read as ぐすり in compounds (e.g., 飲み薬 - のみぐすり), as a standalone word or in this context where it seems to refer to a general medicine for hangover, the more common reading is くすり. The rendaku here seems out of place without a preceding kanji to trigger it.
